Cc: devops@bluepeak.com
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal onboarding — BluePeak Analytics

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. BluePeak's procurement team asked us to start the vendor portal onboarding so we can upload our evidence for the SIG/CAIQ review and share a SOC2 snapshot. Primary goals: get an account in Vendr, confirm SSO service account details, and confirm the evidence retention policy Redwood requires.

Quick context: we currently host logs in S3 (us-west-2), rotate KMS keys monthly, and have a limited SOC2 report (auditor: ClearLine) that covers infrastructure and app. We're happy to start with the SIG matrix and CAIQ answers.

Can you confirm:
- Portal user role we should request (uploader vs security liaison)
- Allowed evidence types, size limits for uploads, and retention windows
- Whether Redwood requires signed attestations vs screenshots for some items

I've attached our partial SIG answers to speed things up.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Security, BluePeak Analytics
security@bluepeak.com
Attachment: SIG_partial_answers.xlsx (xlsx)

From: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com
To: security@bluepeak.com (Aisha Rahman)
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodai.com, priyom_das@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding — BluePeak Analytics

Aisha —

Thanks, this helps. Welcome aboard. High-level next steps from our side:

1) We will provision a Vendr portal account scoped to BluePeak with the role "Security Liaison" so your security lead can upload evidence.
2) We need a named portal owner (full name + email) who can accept the invite and confirm the contact.
3) Ben will validate the CAIQ/SIG artifacts you send and confirm minimal evidence required for items flagged as "in-place" vs "partial."

Couple of specifics:
- Uploads: we accept PDFs, screenshots, and gzipped logs (max 1.5GB per upload).
- Retention: Redwood retains copies of portal evidence for 365 days by default; if you require a shorter TTL, note that on the upload comment.
- SSO: we prefer OIDC/SAML with a service account for automated uploads (service account name + key rotation cadence). If you can't provide SSO, we'll issue a time-limited portal invite and an upload token.

Please reply with the portal owner and whether you'd like us to create a service account request template for your IdP team. I'm attaching our internal onboarding checklist to show required artifacts.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Vendor Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendr-onboarding-checklist.md (text)

—Liam

From: ben_carter@redwoodai.com
To: devops@bluepeak.com, security@bluepeak.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, priyom_das@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding — evidence & SSO checklist

Thanks Liam / Aisha — couple of clarifications from Redwood security (I'll be the point for artifact validation):

- Evidence types we must have for SIG "in-place" answers: screenshots of console settings, signed design docs for key rotation, and KMS key rotation logs for the last 90 days. If you only have summarized attestations, we may ask for limited sampler logs.
- For SOC2 we only need the last 12 months of exception summaries and the last report in full (you've attached that — good).
- SSO/service-account: please name the service account: bluepeak-vendr-uploader@bluepeak.com and provide the SAML metadata XML and a contact email. We'll create a scoped IAM role on our side for uploads. Rotation cadence of 90 days is acceptable.
- Retention policy: Redwood will copy evidence to a secure bucket for 365 days; if you want us to delete sooner, reply with the desired TTL and the reason.

Action items for BluePeak:
- Create service account bluepeak-vendr-uploader@bluepeak.com and send SAML metadata (XML).
- Provide a signed attestation or KMS rotation logs (gzipped) as a pre-signed S3 link.
- Confirm Lina Cho's email and that she can accept vendr@example.com invites.

I'll review the attached CAIQ draft and flag any high-risk gaps. If convenient, let's do a 30-min walkthrough on Thursday (I've copied a Calendly link below).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
Related: https://calendly.com/marissa_cole/30min
Attachment references: sig_mapping.xlsx (we'll map answers to required artifacts)
